race.comment: SANCTUARY (12) is a talented filly who tackled a tougher race at her last run on March 7 and finished sixth behind Medicinal over 1000m in the G3 Ottawa Stakes at Flemington. Started $8.50 there off some impressive trials, so she's obviously shown a bit and needs to be given another chance. VERISMO (8) has not raced since his debut on May 30 over 1150m at Illawarra Grange when he finished fourth, beaten 3.5 lengths. That was also a handy race, he's been gelded since and two recent trials suggest it has improved him. MISS VERONA (10) resumes from a spell after finishing fifth over 1200m at Wagga on May 1. In good hands and has been trialling like an improved showing is on the cards. BIG STORM (1) returns from a lay-off. Ran fifth in latest jump-out at Bendigo. Raced just once to date and finished sixth at this track over 1100m. Respect any market moves.
